food.image_caption: Singhara flour cheela, a crispy water chestnut flour pancake popular during Indian fasting days, can be enjoyed year-round as a nutritious snack.
food.nri_angle: Singhara flour cheela connects diaspora families to Indian fasting traditions during Sawan, making observance possible with ingredients available through online Indian grocery retailers.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Mumbai, Delhi and Jaipur Ranked Among World's Best Street Food Cities
food.excerpt: Top chefs endorse global rankings as Mumbai's khau gallis and Delhi's Mughlai lanes earn international recognition from Time Out and TasteAtlas.
food.nri_angle: Street food serves as a visceral connection to home for the diaspora; international validation may spur more Indian street food concepts abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Biryani King Brings Punjabi Soul Food to Honolulu's Sheridan Street
food.excerpt: A Pakistani-born chef's home-style cooking — from charcoal tandoor naan to oxtail biryani — is winning over Hawaiʻi's food scene and its desi community.
food.image_caption: Biryani King, a new Punjabi restaurant on Honolulu's Sheridan Street, specialises in home-style biryani and North Indian cuisine
food.nri_angle: A Pakistani Punjabi immigrant chef brings home-style cooking to Honolulu, filling a gap for the city's South Asian community
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bengaluru's Legendary MTR Is Opening in Sydney, Bringing Its Century-Old Dosas to Australia
food.excerpt: Australia's assistant minister for multicultural affairs confirmed the 102-year-old Mavalli Tiffin Rooms will franchise in Sydney, adding to a growing list of international outposts.
food.image_caption: MTR (Mavalli Tiffin Rooms), credited with inventing the rava idli, is opening a franchise in Sydney
food.nri_angle: MTR's expansion to Sydney is a landmark moment for the large Indian-Australian community, many of whom have roots in South India and nostalgia for the restaurant's iconic dishes.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Japan Orders Mass Evacuations as Typhoon Dolphin Cancels Over 500 Flights
travel.excerpt: The Category 1 storm is bearing down on southwestern Japan with 144 kph winds, forcing 260,000 to evacuate and shuttering Toyota factories. China's eastern coast braces for landfall within days.
travel.image_caption: Typhoon Dolphin approaching southwestern Japan on Friday. The Category 1 storm has forced the evacuation of nearly 260,000 residents across Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures.
travel.nri_angle: Indian nationals and diaspora travellers in Japan or eastern China should monitor advisories as the storm disrupts flights, rail and ferry services during peak summer travel season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ladakh to Launch India's First High-Altitude Wildlife Safari on Snow Leopard Trails
travel.excerpt: The newly constituted SHAN Conservation Society has directed forest officials to introduce guided jeep safaris across Hemis National Park and other protected areas, modeled on Kaziranga and Ranthambore.
travel.image_caption: Ladakh is home to 477 of India's estimated 718 snow leopards and will introduce guided jeep safaris across its high-altitude wildlife trails. The initiative aims to curb illegal off-roading while creating sustainable livelihoods for local communities.
travel.nri_angle: Ladakh's new safari program offers diaspora travelers a structured way to experience India's Himalayan wildlife, adding to the territory's appeal as a bucket-list destination for Indian-Americans and NRI adventurers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: EVA Air to Launch Nonstop Taipei–Delhi Flights in December, Targeting India-US Transit Market
travel.excerpt: Taiwan's second-largest carrier plans to connect Delhi to its North American network of 10 cities, offering one-stop routes for Indian tech professionals heading to Silicon Valley.
travel.nri_angle: The new Taipei-Delhi route gives NRIs in the US, especially tech workers on the West Coast, a Pacific routing alternative for trips home.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Names Ethiopian Airlines Veteran Tewolde Gebremariam as New CEO
travel.excerpt: The Tata-owned carrier appoints the architect of Ethiopian Airlines' rise as Africa's largest carrier to lead its turnaround following a fatal 2025 crash and record losses exceeding $2 billion.
travel.nri_angle: For the millions of NRIs who rely on Air India for long-haul flights between India and destinations across North America, Europe, and the Gulf, the new CEO's turnaround track record could determine whether the carrier's service, safety, and reliability finally match its expansion ambitions.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Jetstar to Charge Passengers for Overhead Locker Access Starting February 2027
travel.excerpt: Qantas's budget subsidiary will require travelers to purchase a Priority Carry-on add-on to stow bags in overhead bins, joining a global shift toward unbundled airfares.
travel.image_caption: Jetstar Airways will begin charging passengers for overhead locker access on select routes starting February 2027.
travel.nri_angle: Jetstar operates key routes between Australia and Southeast Asia used heavily by the Indian diaspora, and the carry-on fee will affect budget-conscious travelers on these corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ranthambore Safari Bookings Crash as Record Demand Overwhelms New Portal
travel.excerpt: Rajasthan's revamped booking website for India's most popular tiger reserve buckled under massive traffic as the October–December season opened, highlighting surging wildlife tourism demand.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs and international tourists planning India wildlife trips face the same booking gridlock, with the new portal requiring passport uploads and foreign cards often failing on Indian payment gateways.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Trump Signs New Executive Orders to Restrict Birthright Citizenship After Supreme Court Rebuke
carousel.excerpt: The president's narrower approach targets 'birth tourism' and children of 'alien enemies,' weeks after the court struck down his broader ban as unconstitutional.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian Americans on H-1B and other temporary visas whose U.S.-born children hold automatic citizenship could face uncertainty as the administration tests new limits on birthright protections.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Supreme Court Dismisses 'Cheap Publicity' Plea Seeking Criminal Probe Against Justice Varma
carousel.excerpt: The bench rejected the petition calling for an FIR and SIT investigation into the unaccounted cash controversy involving Delhi High Court's former judge Yashwant Varma.
carousel.image_caption: The Supreme Court of India dismissed a petition seeking a criminal probe against Justice Varma, calling it 'cheap publicity' and an abuse of the judicial process.
carousel.nri_angle: The case highlights questions about judicial accountability in India, a matter closely watched by the Indian diaspora invested in the country's institutional integrity.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Russell Crowe to Star in Sci-Fi Thriller Bluefly
carousel.excerpt: The first-time pairing will headline a black-ops Congo thriller directed by Predators filmmaker Nimród Antal, shooting on Australia's Gold Coast later this year.
carousel.image_caption: Priyanka Chopra Jonas, who will star alongside Russell Crowe in the upcoming sci-fi thriller Bluefly, set to film on Australia's Gold Coast.
carousel.nri_angle: Priyanka Chopra Jonas continues to expand her Hollywood portfolio, adding a major sci-fi role opposite an Oscar winner while simultaneously working on SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Women's Asia Cup 2026 Begins August 28 With India-Pakistan Clash on September 5
carousel.excerpt: Seven-time champions India face defending titleholders Sri Lanka and arch-rivals Pakistan in the T20 tournament across 15 matches in Dubai.
carousel.nri_angle: The India-Pakistan women's cricket rivalry draws significant attention from diaspora communities, and the Asia Cup offers NRI fans a chance to follow the team's redemption bid after the 2024 final loss.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Infosys Signs 10-Year AI Deal to Overhaul Crocs' Enterprise Systems
carousel.excerpt: The Bengaluru-headquartered IT services giant will deploy AI-first solutions across the footwear brand's operations, aiming to unify data silos and enable real-time decision-making.
carousel.image_caption: Infosys headquarters in Bengaluru. The IT services giant has signed a 10-year strategic partnership with Crocs to deploy AI-first enterprise solutions.
carousel.nri_angle: The deal signals that AI expertise is becoming the primary currency for India's IT sector, with long-duration transformation contracts replacing traditional outsourcing models.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Sugar Prices Hit Record High on Tight Supplies and Festival Demand
carousel.excerpt: Wholesale prices have surged 10% in a month, with inventories heading for their lowest level in over three decades. The rally is expected to persist through November as festival season consumption peaks.
carousel.image_caption: Wholesale sugar prices in India have surged to record levels amid tight domestic supplies and rising demand ahead of the festival season.
carousel.nri_angle: For Indian households and diaspora families sending money home for festival preparations, the sugar price surge means higher costs for traditional sweets central to celebrations.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
